messages:
jordan_support: FYI customer filed a ticket — their dashboard copy-paste of the API key is returning 401 `invalid_api_key`. They say it worked earlier today then stopped after they rotated keys in their org.
jordan_support: Repro snippet they provided:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H \"Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...\" -d '{\"input\":\"hello\"}'
```
Response: `{\"error\":{\"type\":\"invalid_api_key\",\"message\":\"Invalid API key provided\"}}`

maya_engineer: Quick thought — our dashboard keys have a visible prefix (`rwd-` in the UI) and the new format is `rwd-v2-...`. Did they strip the prefix when copying? That would make it look like a JWT.

frank_engineer: Can reproduce locally by sending a token without the `rwd-` prefix. Server rejects with same error. Example I tried:
```bash
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciIs...\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{\"input\":\"x\"}'
# 401 invalid_api_key
```

frank_engineer: deploy-bot — any recent auth header parsing changes in the last deploy window?

deploy-bot: release/2026-02-18 deployed at 2026-02-18T14:03:12Z — no auth-parser changes. Recent change noted: vault-token-format validation tightened (PR #4127).

maya_engineer: That PR enforces prefix detection for legacy->v2 migration. If a key looks like a JWT we intentionally reject (to prevent accidental paste of unrelated tokens). We'll add a clearer error message. For immediate customer fix: re-issue key (they should use the full `rwd-v2-...` value from dashboard) or paste the value from the download modal (not the shortened display).

jordan_support: I'll reply with repro steps and a screenshot callout pointing at the copy button + full key modal. Also will offer a temporary key re-issue while they confirm rotation.

sophie_support: Please include the curl we used to repro and mention that keys showing like `rwd-v2-****...` are truncated in the UI. Suggest telling customers to click \"show full\" or download the key.

maya_engineer: Follow-up: adding a logging note to indicate when the token lacked the expected `rwd-` prefix so support can distinguish malformed copy-pastes from revoked/expired keys. Filing a small follow-up task to update docs and error message (TICKET-879).

jordan_support: Thanks — will update ticket and ping customer. :thumbsup:
